adopted.:: Separate a key from an inline value or open an indented block.
adopted.\": Open and close an exact single-line STRING literal.
adopted.\"\"\": Open and close an exact multiline STRING literal.
adopted.\\: Introduce an escape inside a string only.
adopted.(: Open expression grouping, a call, or typed constructor.
adopted.): Close expression grouping, a call, or typed constructor.
adopted.[: Open a list literal, index expression, or collection type argument.
adopted.]: Close a list literal, index expression, or collection type argument.
adopted.,: Separate list members and call arguments.
Separate identifier namespaces, access properties, or mark decimal fractions.
adopted._: Separate words inside one identifier segment.
adopted.-: Numeric sign or subtraction only; never a bullet.
adopted./: Numeric division outside strings; path separators occur inside PATH strings.
adopted.==: Strict equality without implicit type coercion.
adopted.!=: Strict inequality without implicit type coercion.
adopted.<: Strict less-than comparison of compatible ordered values.

excluded.=: Use ':' for declaration and '==' for equality.
excluded.{ }: Blocks and objects use indentation, not braces.
excluded.': Single quotes do not delimit strings.
excluded.#: No symbolic comments, headings, IDs, or unquoted color values.
excluded.$: No interpolation, shell-variable, or currency syntax.
excluded.%: Use PERCENTAGE(value); percent signs may occur in strings.
excluded.~: No approximation, home-path, or match operator.
excluded.^: No exponent or XOR operator in Core 0.1.0.
excluded.->: Use IF (...) THEN: or exact references.
excluded.` / ```: Markdown code delimiters are not LCL syntax.
excluded.<tag>: XML tags are not LCL syntax.
excluded.TAB: Tabs are invalid outside string data and invalid for indentation.
